replies.author: Arcane_Horror
replies.body:
I'm guessing some other mod is supposed to see if this ban was valid etc, however 'll still have my say.

Also, damn I'm good! I was kicking some serious ass that match.

So at 0:26 you can see me hitting 2 guys. I had marked down the spots they were on so all I had to do was just quickly turn to the other one when I had hit the original guy off the world. This way I have the best chances  of survival. Next you can see me what I assume you consider snapping to another person. First of all, I was not aware of the teammate behind me. I could not see his yellow helmet, therefore I assumed he might be an enemy and so I attacked. However before that you can also see me turning quickly to bow. This is to make sure I won't be easily backstabbed via giving them kb, allowing me to start a combo or something. And as I said earlier, I attacked the teammate for reasons said above.

At 0:58 I'm assuming you thought that I might have had some kind of no slowdown and possibly autoclicker.
First of all, you bumped into that tree's leaves, making it hard to see what actually happened. Nevertheless, Sprint is broken BEFORE you actually get a hit, but since you derped we can't confirm anything. Plus I was semi behind a tree. And yes, I was indeed holding sprint.
 Also, "why is he still clicking?"
I found this hilarious. That's some Inspector Tenebrous shit right there. As far as I'm aware it's not easy nor smart to stop clicking the very millisecond you kill someone. I kept clicking maybe 0.2 seconds after the kill, so what? I don't always have the greatest reaction times.

At 1:35 I don't exactly know what happened there, but it might have something to do with the guy who hit me, who seems to have used killaura. I don't know if this is true, but that might have killed the knockback. That is such a weird example to really give an answer for.  Fall damage could also have been a factor.

Regarding the next kb scenario, I would really like to know what hit me and where. If it was an arrow, it is known that arrows don't give much kb. Secondly I was on soul sand, which can decrease kb. If I was hit from above with an arrow, then it would decrease kb even more I think, because it would push me down somewhat.

And I really loved the "maybe he moved to the right a little bit to make it look like he took kb". That is some conspiracy shit right there. And lastly I'd say I'm pretty good at decreasing knockback.

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
1. Yes, I notice you did pull out the bow before swinging at them, and you are not clicking with the bow pulled back, therefore, +1.
2. I did not ban for that, nor was going to include that since I already knew it was a glitch. 
3. When you get hit, you should of still taken some knockback, but you didn't; you would of taken your knockback in mid-air before hitting the ground.
4. Yeah, I agree now that you were on soul sand, I saw that you took kb to the right, but the soul sand slowed you down, so +1.
Since you have more points, I will go ahead and get you appealed, sorry for any incovience I have caused.
Appeal is accepted and will be locked in 24 hours.
